lea:title: Ishtar’s Bride
lea:author: Idoru Toei
lea:description:
Uruk, at the height of its glory. The air throbs with the drums of the Ishtar festival, a symphony of devotion that priestess Ninliltu has known since childhood. Consecrated to the goddess, her life is a script of sacred duty, her future a path of serene obedience—until the day she locks eyes with Ashur, a worldly merchant whose very presence whispers of deserts crossed and stars unchained.
He sees in her not a vessel of the divine, but a woman. And in that reflection, a terrifying, exhilarating hope is born: the dream of a life that is hers alone.
Embrace the ache in this male romance engineered around Jungian ideas. Deep explorations into timeless topics set against a historical context. Sex included.
